rows.text: You come across a massive fragment of the Mirror of Transcendence. Three candles are placed beneath it as offerings.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I've been imprisoned in this mirror fragment for a long time. Believe in the Beauty, and I will grant all your wishes," says the Mirror Holder in the mirror.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Make a wish to get her out of the mirror.
You don't want to make a wish.
